title: Listening Drill — Bus noise check
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Bus noise check
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about bus noise by the main road. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the first stop. Record the first reading at three. The quantity we're comparing is sound level. Use the sound meter marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, note any unusually loud vehicles. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.

questions.instructions: Choose the option that completes the note.
Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.
